title: A Protocol for the Deadline
premise: Theo Yarrow, a burned-out private security contractor, receives a calendar invite from his former handler, Marcus Vane — sent hours after Vane's body was pulled from the Thames. The meeting pulls him into a conspiracy surrounding Halcyon Vault, the encrypted inheritance of a dead oligarch that names Theo's sister as beneficiary. Hunted by the firm he once served and the state actors who want the vault sealed, Theo must decide whether to expose the truth about the incident that broke him or trade it for his sister's life. In the end, he burns the secret publicly, sacrificing his reputation and freedom to save her, and walks away knowing loyalty was the lie that kept him alive.
about_author: Dominic Coldharbour is the pen name of a former maritime security consultant who spent a decade contracting in ports from Rotterdam to Lagos before turning to fiction. He writes thrillers about men whose professional silence finally runs out.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Theo Yarrow, sleepless since a botched extraction in Riga, receives a calendar invite from Marcus Vane — his old handler, confirmed dead that morning. POV: Theo. The beat is dread sharpening into compulsion: he goes, because the invite includes a detail only Vane knew.

chapters.title: Empty Chair
chapters.summary: At a Canary Wharf café, Vane never appears; instead a courier delivers a burner phone and a key to a storage unit. Firm cleaners arrive to sanitize the meeting. POV: Theo. Emotional beat: paranoia curdling into grief as Theo realizes Vane scheduled his own death as a message.

chapters.title: What Vane Left Behind
chapters.summary: In the storage unit: files on Halcyon Vault, an encrypted inheritance naming Theo's estranged sister Lena as beneficiary, and a recording implicating Theo's own firm in the Riga incident. POV: Theo with an intercut of Lena in Lisbon. Beat: guilt — the secret worth killing for is his.

chapters.title: The Firm Calls
chapters.summary: Theo's ex-boss, Director Ilse Brandt, offers him reinstatement if he surrenders Vane's materials. He lies; she knows. A tail appears outside his flat. POV: alternating Theo and Brandt. Beat: the seduction of belonging versus the nausea of complicity.

chapters.title: Lisbon
chapters.summary: Theo reaches Lena ahead of the firm's retrieval team, but she refuses to trust the brother who vanished after Riga. An attempt on them both forces a fragile alliance. POV: split Theo/Lena. Beat: resentment cracking into reluctant loyalty under fire.

chapters.title: The Middleman
chapters.summary: A state liaison, Calloway, reveals a third player: the oligarch's heirs want the vault opened quietly and everyone who knows it exists erased. He offers Theo survival in exchange for the Riga file. POV: Theo. Beat: temptation — the price of survival is exactly the truth he's carrying.

chapters.title: Dead Drop
chapters.summary: Theo arranges a trade through Vane's old network, but the meet is blown — Brandt's team and Calloway's both converge. Lena is taken; Theo escapes with only half the key. POV: Theo. Beat: betrayal and self-loathing; his tradecraft got someone he loves caught.

chapters.title: Terms of Exchange
chapters.summary: Brandt offers the swap: Lena for the vault access and Theo's silence on Riga. Theo pretends to negotiate while Vane's final recording reveals the vault contains proof the firm orchestrated Riga itself. POV: Theo. Beat: cold clarity — loyalty was always the leash.

chapters.title: Halcyon
chapters.summary: Climax at the vault facility: Theo trades himself for Lena, then broadcasts the Riga evidence and the inheritance record publicly before Brandt can contain it. Calloway's faction turns on the firm to save themselves. POV: Theo and Lena. Beat: fury transmuted into sacrifice.

chapters.title: After the Deadline
chapters.summary: Weeks later: the firm is under inquiry, Brandt vanished, and Theo faces charges he accepts without bargaining. Lena visits; forgiveness is partial and real. He sleeps through the night for the first time. POV: Theo. Beat: costly peace — truth bought at the price of everything else.
